meta.title: {site} — {pixels, number} pixels for rent
meta.description: {pixels, number} pixels, {price} per pixel per year. Rent a piece of the wall and put your picture, drawing or text with a link on it.

common.pricePerPixel: {cents, plural, one {# cent} other {# cents}} per pixel

header.slogan: Leave your mark on the internet

footer.inspired: Inspired by The Million Dollar Homepage (2005). We are not affiliated with it in any way.

wall.keyboardHelp: Use the arrow keys to move, + and − to zoom, Enter to open the spot in the middle and Esc to close a window.
wall.imageAlt: The wall of {pixels, number} pixels with all current rentals
wall.noscript: Turn on JavaScript to zoom in, search and rent pixels. You can still click rentals on the wall.
wall.searchMany: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} — pick one:
wall.coordsIdle: Point at the wall to see coordinates
wall.cornerSet: First corner at block {bx}, {by}. Move and press Enter for the opposite corner.

popup.label: Spot details
popup.freeText: Block {bx}, {by} ({position}) costs {price} per year. You can also select a bigger area.
popup.takenText: The content will appear on the wall after it is approved.
popup.holdText: Someone is renting it right now. If they do not finish within a few minutes, it will be free again.

pages.comingInPhase: It will be ready in phase {phase} of the project.
pages.notFoundText: Sorry, there is nothing at this address. Maybe the link is old or mistyped.

email.footer: {site} — a wall of a million pixels for rent.
email.item: Rental of a {w} × {h} px area on the wall ({position}) for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}
email.notVatPayer: The seller is not a VAT payer.

paid.subject: Payment received — your pixels are waiting for approval
paid.intro: Thank you for your order. We received your payment of {amount}. We will check your content, usually within {hours} hours, and let you know when it is on the wall.
paid.start: The rental period starts on the day the content is approved.
paid.mine: You can see your rentals in My pixels:

approved.subject: Your pixels are on the wall!
approved.intro: Good news: “{title}” was approved and is now on the wall at {position}. Your rental is valid until {until}.
approved.shareText: I have my own spot on {site}!

lateRefund.subject: We are sorry — your payment was refunded
lateRefund.intro: Your payment of {amount} reached us after the reservation of your spot had ended, and meanwhile someone else rented that space.
lateRefund.refund: We have refunded the whole amount. Depending on your bank it can take a few days to appear on your account.

email.appeal: If you think this is a mistake, reply to this e-mail or write to {contact} and mention rental no. {no}. We will look at it again.

login.subject: Your sign-in link for {site}
login.intro: Click the button to sign in to My pixels. The link works once and is valid for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.ignore: If you did not expect this e-mail, you can ignore it. Nobody can sign in without the link.

changeApproved.subject: Your change was approved
changeApproved.intro: The new version of “{title}” is now on the wall at {position}.

rejected.subject: Your content was not approved
rejected.intro: We could not approve the content for your spot at {position} (“{title}”).
rejected.upload: You can send different content until {until}. Your spot stays reserved for you until then.
rejected.refundNote: If no new content arrives by then, we will refund the whole payment automatically.

changesRequested.subject: Please adjust your content
changesRequested.intro: Your content for the spot at {position} (“{title}”) needs a change before we can put it on the wall.

changeRejected.subject: Your change was not approved
changeRejected.intro: We could not approve the change to “{title}” at {position}. Your previous content stays on the wall.
changeRejected.again: You can send a different change in My pixels.

refunded.subject: Your payment was refunded
refunded.noReupload: We did not receive new content for your spot at {position} in time, so we refunded the whole payment of {amount} and released the spot.
refunded.rejected: Your order for the spot at {position} could not be approved, so we refunded the whole payment of {amount} and released the spot.
refunded.admin: We refunded {amount} for your rental “{title}” at {position}.
refunded.bank: Depending on your bank it can take a few days to appear on your account.

hidden.subject: Your pixels were hidden for now
hidden.intro: Your content “{title}” at {position} was hidden from the wall while we look into it.
hidden.next: We will let you know the result. If the content is fine, it will be back on the wall.

removed.subject: Your content was removed from the wall
removed.intro: We removed “{title}” at {position} from the wall because it breaks our content rules.
removed.terms: As stated in the terms of service, content removed for breaking the rules is not refunded.

reportReceived.subject: We received your report ({reference})
reportReceived.intro: Thank you for your report about rental no. {no}. We will look into it as soon as possible and let you know what we decided.

reportDecided.subject: Decision on your report ({reference})
reportDecided.actioned: We checked the content you reported (rental no. {no}) and took action: it is no longer shown on the wall.
reportDecided.dismissed: We checked the content you reported (rental no. {no}) and found that it does not break our content rules, so it stays on the wall.
reportDecided.thanks: Thank you for helping us keep the wall friendly.

transferOffer.subject: Someone is giving you a spot on {site}
transferOffer.intro: The owner of the spot “{title}” ({size} at {position}) on {site} wants to give it to you. The rental is valid until {until}.
transferOffer.valid: The link is valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. If you do not want the spot, just ignore this e-mail.

transferDone.subject: Your spot was handed over
transferDone.intro: The spot “{title}” ({position}) now belongs to {email}. It is no longer in your My pixels.

accountDeleted.subject: Your account was deleted
accountDeleted.intro: Your account and personal data were deleted as you asked. Receipts are kept for as long as the law requires.
accountDeleted.rentals: Rentals that are still running stay on the wall until they end.

staffInvite.subject: You can now use the administration of {site}
staffInvite.intro: You were given the role of {role, select, admin {administrator} other {moderator}}. Sign in with this e-mail address and set up two-factor login with an authenticator app.

rent.title: Rent pixels
rent.salesPaused: Renting is paused for maintenance at the moment. Please try again later.
rent.alreadyPaid: Your last order is paid and waiting for approval.

rent.holdExpiredKept: Your picture and details are kept and come along when you reserve again.
rent.changingPlace: You are choosing a new place. Your current place {position} stays reserved until you reserve the new one, for
rent.changingPlaceContent: Your picture moves to the new place if it has the same size; otherwise you will add a picture for the new size.
rent.selectHelp: Drag on the wall to select the area you want to rent. It snaps to blocks of 10 × 10 px. Drag the corners to resize it or drag the area to move it. Zoom with the mouse wheel; to move the wall, use the right mouse button or the “Move wall” tool.
rent.selectHelpTouch: On a phone: zoom in with two fingers, tap the first corner, then the opposite corner, and adjust the area with its corner handles.
rent.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}} of your selection {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} already taken (red). Move or resize the area.
rent.tooSmall: The smallest rental is {min, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}.
rent.tooLarge: The largest rental is {max, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}.

upload.limits: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF (first frame), up to {mb} MB and {px} × {px} px.
upload.frameHelp: Drag the picture to choose the part you want; zoom with the slider or the mouse wheel. The frame has the exact proportions of your area.
upload.smallWarning: Your area is small: fine details and small text will not be readable. Consider renting a bigger area.
upload.processingNote: The server makes the final picture with the same filter (with sharper scaling) and removes all hidden data such as the GPS location.
upload.filterIntro: Your area has {w} × {h} = {pixels, number} pixels. The filter turns your photo into exactly that many pixels: the bigger the area, the more detail.
upload.result: Result: {count, plural, one {# dot} other {# dots}} of {size} × {size} px.
upload.pixelSizeHelp: 1 px keeps the most detail; bigger pixels look more like retro pixel art.
upload.dither: Dithering: mixes dots of the palette colours for smoother shades

draw.autosave: Your drawing is saved in this browser while you work.

text.oneBlock: A single 10 × 10 px block holds just one letter or symbol.
text.tooLong: The text does not fit. Shorten it, choose a smaller size or rent a bigger area.
